title: Info Set Item
description: Single entry from the generator output feed.

iTp.title: Item Type
iTp.description: Numeric discriminator identifying the kind of item entry.

gId.title: Group Id
gId.description: Identifier of the generator group responsible for this entry.

gIx.title: Group Index
gIx.description: Requirement or message code as emitted by the generator.

p.title: Path
p.description: Optional path that contextualises the item entry.

anyOf.description: Numeric tuple representation when the generator emits version triples or coordinates.

d.title: Data
d.description: Supplemental data emitted with the item. Can be a string or an array of numbers.

m.title: Message
m.description: Human readable context for the entry.

fs.title: Feature Sets
fs.description:
Optional keyed metrics attached to this item entry.

Properties:
• count (int)

info_set_feature_set_entry.title: Feature Set Metric
info_set_feature_set_entry.description: Describes a single metric collected while processing a content feature set.

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of occurrences attributed to this feature.
